_comment: Clinician sign-off manifest. validate.py FAILS the build if any emitted rule with severity 'contraindicated' or 'major' is neither listed in 'signed' (status 'signed') nor covered by grandfather_legacy. A 'signed' entry with a placeholder reviewer or status!='signed' produces a WARNING (build proceeds, flagged) — used for rules still awaiting review. This mirrors the KB clinician sign-off workflow; content remains advisory and requires local verification.
grandfather_note: The 38 rules migrated from interaction-rules.js v0.1.0-starter were the app's existing shipped starter set; they retain their original reviewDate and are grandfathered here. New rules require explicit sign-off below.
